svg.title: The positive square root fixes the branch. In particular this coupling is calibrated to the Wilson charge before it is used in the Ward equations. Transfer (TR76) to P ′, denoting its coefficients again by κ, d, e. The coefficient comparison survives this asymptotically identity change, so d/g2 X →d2. The exact Ward equations (TR77) still hold.
